title: Case 2: The Vanishing File
story: The finance report disappeared from the shared folder. The delete left a trace in the shell histories.
goal: Find which user ran rm on report-q3.xlsx.
hints: grep can search many files at once.
grep rm /case/hist_*.txt shows the file name too.

Run:
grep -l report-q3 /case/hist_*.txt
Then answer: ravi
socratic: Which file is the oldest witness?
Do two files tell different stories?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
